intro: Unmatched Fire Resistance for Your Most Important Documents - Tested and Certified at international Laboratories

features.title: Ultrakey Double Locking Mechanism
features.text: Safeguard your belongings with the Ultra key Double Locking Mechanism, which offers superior protection through its dual-lock design. This advanced system ensures reliable and robust security for your documents.

features.title: Advanced Shooting Bolt System
features.text: Equipped with a cutting-edge shooting bolt system, our locker features two front active shooting bolts that extend and retract seamlessly with the lock's operation. And two rear fixed shooting bolts that remain permanently engaged with the safe’s body, providing robust resistance against forced entry and ensuring your documents are always secure.

features.title: Fire Resistant Safe Certified by ECB-S
features.text: Certified by ECB-S certification body, our locker provides a minimum of 60 minutes of fire resistance. This ensures that your documents are safeguarded against fire damage while adhering to the highest safety standards.

features.title: Double Walled Body & Door
features.text: Our locker is designed with a durable, fire-resistant double-walled body and door, filled with specialized fire-resistant material. This advanced construction significantly slows down heat transfer, ensuring maximum protection for your documents and keeping them safe and secure in the event of a fire.

features.title: Tongue & Groove Construction
features.text: Equipped with advanced tongue and groove construction that enhances security and provides superior fire resistance. This design ensures tight seals and improved structural integrity, effectively protecting your documents from fire by preventing hot gases and smoke from seeping inside.

features.title: Advanced Snap Shut Mechanism
features.text: The innovative advanced snap-shut mechanism ensures secure and effortless door closure. Providing added security for your documents, this mechanism is designed for durability and ease of use.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
